line.name: HVC La Decoración
line.description: CORRECTION TO AN INITIAL ASSUMPTION: Mac filename prefix 'Dec' was assumed might mean 'Decade' (a 10th-anniversary line) - research ruled this out (that line only has 2 vitolas, Toro and a Robusto, not matching all 4 photographed vitolas). The real product is 'La Decoración' ('Reinier Lorenzo's Ode to Cuban Artistry'), a new regular-production line shown at PCA 2026, shipping to stores from ~April 7, 2026. Site already lists HVC with 5 other lines - this is a genuinely new 6th line.
line.wrapper: Ecuadorian (also referred to as 'Ecuadorian 2000' in some sourcing)
line.factory: Nicaragua - one source names the Aganorsa Leaf factory, not independently corroborated by a second source, flagged rather than asserted as settled.

vitolas.name: Robusto
vitolas.notes: Matches the Mac photo. A 4-cigar sampler (one of each vitola), limited to 300 units, was also released - likely explains the box-open shot.

research_notes: Factory attribution single-sourced (Aganorsa Leaf), not independently corroborated. Binder leaf variety not specified in sources found.
